subject: CLASS-ID paragraph
notes: Object-class-name-1 names the class and literal-1 externalizes it. The observable half is that the WORD keeps naming the class while an AS phrase is written - the golden's REPOSITORY CLASS entry and its USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE clause both resolve on the declared word - which is also why OoClassSymbol.CsName is deliberately NOT derived from the externalized name (the emitted type name is a wire contract with PicInfo.ClrType). 8.3.2.2 lists no reference form that takes a class's externalized name. kb/Work PB303.
